k4.generatedPrompt: Create ONE isolated 2D pixel-art effect reference for a sidescrolling action game: a BLACK LIQUID INK SPRAY shot horizontally toward the LEFT from a pressure nozzle located at the far RIGHT edge of the effect. No character, no nozzle drawn, no tank, no scenery, no labels. One continuous short broad horizontal liquid jet, attached thin root at RIGHT, broad irregular blunt leading front at LEFT. Overall silhouette roughly 3.5 times wider than tall. Dense opaque near-black liquid core occupies almost entire silhouette, a few large lumpy fingers and hanging heavy droplets at front/bottom convey viscous ink under pressure. Controlled broad stepped pixel clusters, 2-3 flat dark shades only: near black #25242B dominant, sparse muted charcoal #3C3943 and slate #57525B internal facets. No bright highlight, no white rim, no outline stroke, no glow, no neon, no flame shapes, no smoke cloud, no mist/soft edges/blur/antialias gradients, no wispy long hair spikes. Readable chunky low-resolution sprite effect with hard rectangular pixel edges, intended to reduce to approximately 144x44 logical pixels. Keep whole silhouette plus 15 percent transparent padding on all sides. Transparent background true. This is a static material/silhouette source for deterministic pixel motion, not a spritesheet.
k4.damageContract: Only the 650ms hold emits damaging ink; once per target per spray. No body contact damage, no residual puddle. Viewer rectangle is a trial envelope, not a runtime collider.
k4.sourceTool: built-in image_gen; generated still then deterministic palette quantization and pixel motion

h3.method: Rank existing pixel/color region crossings by distance to each contour, then advance an even integer pixel budget every50ms. Spread tied one-pixel rings around their contour to avoid SDF threshold popping. Hard binary alpha, no blended RGB or random dither. Retain original eight keys at their original timestamps. Add intermediate shape keys only; keep1600ms release and all subsequent composite pixels/timing exact.

policy: User will choose spray envelope in preview. Do not set gameplay sizes or modify combat/Unity. Preserve generated raw, prompt, input sources, native effect/formation frames and timing; standalone HTML embeds all images.
